search_results.title: Framework Adds Native Multi-Agent Memory
search_results.snippet: A popular open source agent framework shipped a built-in shared memory store, letting multiple agents read and write the same session state.

search_results.title: Enterprise Pilot Automates Support Triage With Agents
search_results.snippet: A mid-size software company reported a pilot where an agent pipeline triaged and routed 40 percent of inbound support tickets without a human.

search_results.title: Researchers Publish Agent Evaluation Benchmark
search_results.snippet: A research lab released a new benchmark suite for scoring tool-using agents on multi-step tasks with partial credit.

search_results.title: Browser Vendor Ships Built-In Agent Mode
search_results.snippet: A major browser added an experimental mode that lets an agent fill forms and navigate pages on a user's behalf, gated behind a permission prompt.
